description_en: Queries the result of a member deletion check
description_zh: 调用GetAccountDeletionCheckResult查询成员删除检查结果
name: GetAccountDeletionCheckResult

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member that you want to delete
parameters.name: account_id

AccountDeletionCheckResultInfo.description_en: The result of the deletion check for the member

AbandonableChecks.description_en:
The check items that you can choose to ignore for the member deletion.

This parameter may be returned if the value of AllowDelete is true
AbandonableChecks.description_zh:
您可以选择放弃并继续执行成员删除的检查项。

当AllowDelete为true时，可能返回该参数值

items.description_en:
The check items that you can choose to ignore for the member deletion.

This parameter may be returned if the value of AllowDelete is true
items.description_zh:
您可以选择放弃并继续执行成员删除的检查项。
当AllowDelete为true时，可能返回该参数值

CheckId.description_en: The ID of the check item

CheckName.description_en: The name of the cloud service to which the check item belongs
CheckName.description_zh: 检查项所属的云服务名称

Description.description_en: The description of the check item
Description.example: 存在云产品实例运行，请联系客服人员提工单处理。

AllowDelete.description_en:
Indicates whether the member can be deleted. Valid values:

true: The member can be deleted.
false: The member cannot be deleted
AllowDelete.description_zh:
是否允许删除。取值：
true：允许删除。
false：不允许删除

NotAllowReason.description_en:
The reasons why the member cannot be deleted.

This parameter is returned only if the value of AllowDelete is false
NotAllowReason.description_zh:
不允许删除的原因。
当AllowDelete为false时，返回该参数值

items.description_en:
The reasons why the member cannot be deleted.

This parameter is returned only if the value of AllowDelete is false
items.description_zh:
不允许删除的原因。
当AllowDelete为false时，返回该参数值

CheckId.description_en: The ID of the check item

CheckName.description_en: The name of the cloud service to which the check item belongs
CheckName.description_zh: 检查项所属的云服务名称

Description.description_en: The description of the check item
Description.example: This account is an Enterprise Finance associated account. Please remove the financial association of this account before deleting it.

Status.description_en:
The status of the check. Valid values:

PreCheckComplete: The check is complete.
PreChecking: The check is in progress
Status.description_zh:
检查状态。取值：

PreCheckComplete：检查完成。
PreChecking：检查中
